dogecoin.text: “Dogecoin (#DOGE) saw more liquidations than Bitcoin (#BTC ) at one point on April 24. This shows there is a significantly high demand for trading the meme cryptocurrency even as Bitcoin and Ether (#ETH) struggle to recover.” https://t.co/VKPd1JKlK4

“#Cryptocurrency is just an asset to invest in. #Bitcoin is kind of like a digital version of gold. #Ethereum is a digital version of a currency. #Dogecoin went from being a cryptocurrency joke to now becoming something that’s becoming a digital currency.”
